context.passage:
Time Wise Payroll Software
Elevate your small business with Time Wise, the all-in-one time sheet and payroll
management system. Tailored for small businesses and designed to simplify your
workflow, the Time Wise app provides automated payroll processing and customizable
reports. With Time Wise's user-friendly interface and robust support system, tracking
employees' work hours and ensuring accurate, timely payroll disbursements has never
been easier. To stay competitive, Time Wise has not changed its subscription rate
since the software was rolled out. The basic monthly cost is still just $35 plus
$6 per employee. In celebration of our fifth anniversary, new customers get a
10 percent discount on their first-month charges if they subscribe during May.
Please visit www.timewise.com/subscribe for details.
TECH REVIEW TODAY
Posted by/Job title: Andrew Klossner, Office Manager, Redmond Printing
Product reviewed: Time Wise Payroll Software
Date posted: May 23
E-mail address (optional): a.klossner@redmondprinting.com
My company, Redmond Printing, purchased the Time Wise software earlier this
month specifically because it is geared toward businesses of our size. It is reasonably
priced, has various useful features, and is easy to install. Initially, though, I had a
problem uploading personnel data from our old system. When I contacted the
Time Wise support staff for help using the app's live chat feature, they responded
quickly and resolved the issue within minutes. My only frustration is with the
program's periodic maintenance procedures, which disrupt round-the-clock access to
time sheet data.
108
To:
Andrew Klossner <a.klossner@redmondprinting.com>
From:
Femke Haagsma <femke.haagsma@timewise.com>
Date:
May 25
Subject:
Time Wise
Dear Mr. Klossner,
Thank you for signing up for Time Wise! We are committed to providing a seamless
xperience for our customers, and we apologize that your introduction to our platform ha
ot been as smooth as we had hoped. As a gesture of appreciation, we will apply ou
anniversary special to your company for an additional six months.
Rest assured—we are working hard to reduce the number and length of downtime periods.
I hope you will reassess our service and consider updating your testimonial in the near
future.
Sincerely,
Femke Haagsma
Time Wise Customer Support
